description:
Many believers wrestle with end-time anxiety, hard-to-understand prophecies, and questions about God’s presence in daily life. In this episode, we explore what Scripture says about coming events, personal prayer, faith versus presumption, and the meaning behind passages such as Psalm 139, Revelation 12, Ezekiel 9, and more. Join us for a grounded, Bible-centered conversation designed to bring peace, clarity, and confidence in God’s leading.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 

1.  I have recently been having anxiety attacks concerning the second coming and am convinced that Jesus is coming within this presidency. I know that “no man knoweth the day nor hour” and “ lean not on your own understanding”. For clarity, what events will lead up to the national Sunday law? Are we told in the Bible whether it will happen gradually or suddenly? What does having an American pope mean for these end times? 

2. I live alone & therefore pray alone. Does God still hear me and remain present with me?  When I pray by myself, am I still in God’s presence? 

3.  Can you please help me follow and understand David's thought process in Psalm 139:19-24? I read this, but then in Matthew 5:44, Jesus tells us to love our enemies. I know we've been taught that the Bible doesn't contradict itself, so what am I missing here?  How does Psalm 139:19-24 fit with Jesus’ command to love our enemies in Matthew 5:44? 

4. When does faith become presumption? Can you please give distinct characteristics of the two & cite Bible texts? 

5. The woman went into the wilderness after she gave birth to the male child in Revelation 12:5. Who is the "they" in verse 6 that should feed her? Is she the same woman in Revelation 17:1-6 and Revelation 18? Who is the Bible referring to in Revelation 12:6?

6.  When Moses went to Jethro, his father-in-law, before leading Israel, and later returned to meet his family after the deliverance, did he go 40 years without seeing them, or were there frequent visits during that time?  How often did Moses see his family during the 40 years of leading Israel? 

7. Do all 66 books of the Bible have prophetic content? I know there are different types of prophecies, but it seems that all of them contain some element of prophecy. 

8. Could you please explain the differences between body, spirit, and soul? What happens to each when we die? 

9. Can you please explain Ezekiel chapter 9?
